objective: Identify the twisted triple product T on the inseparable blocks of the coupled family (3-surgery on the closure of sigma_1^3 ... sigma_{n-1}^3 times a full twist, n = 3m) of UT3-INTERACT-PROBE-20261026-001, at block sizes 3, 5, 7 (and 9), up to change of basis: its alternating and non-alternating parts, its symmetries, and whether the block counts 7, 244, 8176, 367684 have a closed form.
status: Proved by TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001B-P001: on 3-surgery on the coupled knots (trefoil chain times a full twist), n = 6, 9, 12, the twisted triple product is one inseparable block of dimension 3, 5, 7 plus trefoil-type singletons; on the block the Bockstein map a -> T(a, a, .) has rank d - 1 and the alternating part is nonzero; block counts 244, 8176, 367684. The counts change when only the alternating part changes, so they reflect one choice of a part Borromean moves change freely; no closed form found.
title: The triple forms of the coupled blocks
